text: Port Ansgar, Nov. 13 — Kestrelline Rail will build its new maintenance depot in Port Ansgar, according to people familiar with the matter. The facility, planned for the north freight district, is expected to support the company’s expanding coastal fleet and handle overnight servicing, wheel inspections and parts storage, the people said. Final design work is nearing completion, with ground preparation due to begin in January and major construction slated for late spring. The depot is projected to create about 180 jobs once operational, including mechanics, dispatchers and safety technicians. Kestrelline executives are expected to formally announce the site selection next week, people familiar with the matter said.
